protocol.holdout_policy: Reuse the pinned, verified unopened predecessor reservation; never reuse an opened test cohort
protocol.selection: capture + 0.2 AP on the fixed development set; exact ties retain earliest checkpoint, then declared LR grid order; no MSE selector
protocol.routine_validation: object metrics only for SLiCS; full joint reconstruction only on the frozen final holdout
protocol.checkpoint_schedule: SLiCS: 0, every 500, 7640 and 10640; GGF guided: 0, every 500 and 3000; GGF candidates include a shared 7640-update warm-up
protocol.primary_small_readouts: fixed category slots for BOTH methods
protocol.seed_scope: Independent training orders conditional on a common deterministic SVD initializer and fixed data
protocol.scope: Tests specified supervised controls; no claim to settle all possible supervised methods or guarantee acceptance.
